title: ServisFirst Bank Announces New Houston, Texas Market President
summary: Read the latest from ServisFirst Bank.

## ***Veteran Banker, Cody Cannon, to Accelerate Houston Market Expansion and Team Growth***


**HOUSTON, Texas** –[ServisFirst Bank](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/___https:/servisfirstbank.com/___.YzJ1OnNlcnZpc2ZpcnN0YmFuazE2ODQ4NDI5NDUwNTU6YzpvOjYxOGQ3ZDhmNGEwY2FjZDYxYjg0OTQ2ZGMwNTU3NDNiOjY6MTJhNjplMzcyZjUyZDgzNjcyZTU4OWUxZGFhMjU5NjkxNGExZDdhOTZjY2RjZWNiYzIxNzkxNzVjNjQ0NjhlNjYzMGVkOnA6VDpO) , a subsidiary of ServisFirst Bancshares (NYSE:SFBS), is pleased to announce the addition of **Cody Cannon** as **Executive Vice President, Houston Market President.** With more than 25 years of banking experience, Cannon will lead ServisFirst Bank's Houston market, overseeing the continued growth of the Bank's commercial banking presence and building a high-performing local team.


“We are ecstatic to welcome Cody to ServisFirst Bank as we continue expanding our presence in Texas,” states Christopher Dvorachek, Regional CEO of ServisFirst Bank Texas. “His extensive commercial banking experience, proven leadership and track record of building successful teams make him an outstanding fit for our organization. Cody's client-first approach and deep understanding of the Houston market will be instrumental as we continue delivering exceptional service and customized financial solutions to businesses throughout the region.”


As Executive Vice President, Houston Market President, Cannon will lead efforts to establish and grow ServisFirst Bank's Houston team while driving commercial banking relationships throughout the market. Throughout his career, he has successfully launched and expanded banking operations, recruited high-performing teams and developed long-term relationships with middle-market and commercial clients across a variety of industries. Cannon brings extensive experience in commercial banking, relationship management and market leadership. Throughout his career, he has managed large commercial loan and deposit portfolios, structured complex credit facilities and delivered comprehensive financial solutions for businesses spanning manufacturing, distribution, construction, engineering, franchise, technology and other key industries. He has also led market expansion initiatives, recruited top banking talent and consistently generated significant commercial loan and deposit growth.


> "I am honored to join ServisFirst Bank during such an exciting time of growth," states Cannon. "I look forward to building more meaningful relationships throughout the Houston market and helping businesses and individuals achieve their financial goals."


A graduate of Texas A&M University, Cannon is an active member of the Economic Alliance Houston Port Region and the Association for Corporate Growth (ACG). He previously served on the Advisory Council for the Center for New Venture & Entrepreneurship at Texas A&M University and as a Board Member of The Entrepreneurship Institute. He currently serves on the Board of Devereux School.


For more information regarding ServisFirst Bank’s recent addition in Houston, Texas please contact Krista Conlin at Krista@KCProjects.net. ## **ABOUT SERVISFIRST BANK**


ServisFirst Bank is a full-service commercial bank focused on commercial banking, correspondent banking, treasury management, private banking and the professional consumer market, emphasizing competitive products, state-of-the-art technology and a focus on quality service. Recently, the Bank announced that its assets exceed $18 billion. The Bank offers sophisticated treasury management products, Internet banking, home mortgage lending, remote deposit express banking, and highly competitive rates.


ServisFirst Bank was formed in May 2005, and has offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. In April 2015, and annually thereafter, ServisFirst Bank has earned investment- grade ratings and a stable outlook from Kroll Bond Rating Agency (KBRA), which measures companies’ financial fundamentals. ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. files periodic reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
